nota: Texts of the Arena tab, loaded when the tab opens (their weight is not in the game door). The game speaks English only today.

ui.arena_nota: Your node sits at the center. NPC patrols guard the depths: pick one and fight with your wave troops. People appear on this sea when you import their signed defense.
ui.arena_mapa_aria: World map: Hexelion in the center, measured; Doogee in fog, not measured; NPC places and you around them. The same places are buttons below.
ui.arena_escena_aria: The fight, live: your troops and theirs, drawn as their own waves. The result and the full log are written below.
ui.arena_escuadra_nota: Pick up to {n} troops. Their numbers are rebuilt from their seed: nobody brings forged stats.
ui.arena_practica: Practice squad (not yours yet): summon waves in My node › Army to fight with your own.
ui.arena_tope: A squad holds {n} troops at most.
ui.arena_vacia: Pick at least one troop for your squad.
ui.arena_final: {res} in {r} rounds · life left: you {a}% · them {b}%.
ui.arena_pve_nota: Practice against a patrol: synthetic, it does not touch your rating or your resources (loot is NO_DATA until its rule is signed).
ui.arena_semilla: Seed {s}… · log {h}… Same seed, same fight: anyone can replay it.
ui.duelo_nota: No server: you swap signed packages through any channel you choose. The seed of each duel is committed and revealed by both sides, so nobody picks it alone. If your rival commits and does not reveal within 900 game cycles, you can claim the duel by abandonment.
ui.duelo_publicada: Your defense is signed ({f}). Share it: whoever imports it sees you on their sea and can challenge you.
ui.duelo_ok_defensa: Defense of {p} verified: they are on your sea now. Pick them and press Challenge.
ui.duelo_reto_hecho: Challenge signed ({f}). Send it to your rival and keep this tab open until the duel resolves.
ui.duelo_recibido: {p} challenges your defense. Accept to commit and reveal your half of the seed.
ui.duelo_aceptado: Accepted and signed ({f}). Send the answer back: when they reveal, the fight plays on both screens.
ui.duelo_respondido: {p} answered your challenge. Reveal to fight.
ui.duelo_revelado: Revealed ({f}). Send it to your rival so they replay the same fight.
ui.duelo_visto: Your rival revealed: here is the fight. Same seed, same result on both screens.
ui.duelo_reclamado: Abandonment claimed and signed ({f}). Send it: they can check it.
ui.duelo_abandono_ok: Abandonment claim verified: they committed and did not reveal.
ui.duelo_fase_retado: You challenged {p}: waiting for their answer
ui.duelo_rating: Your local rating: {r}{prov} · {n} verified duels in this tab. No central leaderboard.
ui.duelo_copiado: Copied: paste it wherever you send it.
ui.duelo_nd_copiar: NO_DATA · this browser does not let the page write to the clipboard: use Download.
ui.duelo_nd_id: NO_DATA · no identity on this device: create your key to sign duels.
ui.duelo_con_id: Key created: you can sign now.
ui.nodos_nota: Two house accounts, one node each. Each node fights with what was measured on its own hardware; what was not measured fights in fog. A modest machine is a character, not a handicap.
ui.nodos_n0: Played in your browser from the seed. Nothing left this device.
ui.nodos_firmado: Signed by {q}. The signature covers the log hash; anyone can replay it from the seed.
ui.nodos_sin_id: Signing needs your identity in this browser.
ui.nodos_consent: I consent to send this signed bout to the rack's review queue (a second signature).
ui.nodos_enviando: Asking the rack for a challenge…
ui.nodos_recibo: Receipt: {e} · {f}. Nothing is published without human review.
ui.nodos_aria: Live bout between the two house nodes
ui.nodos_cedulas_h: Node cards: what each node measured (Hexelion · Doogee)
ui.nodos_paso1_p: Your browser identity seals this bout's log. It stays on this device.
ui.nodos_paso2_h: Step 2 of 2 · Consent and send to the rack
ui.nodos_paso2_p: A second, separate signature: your consent to send this signed bout for review.
ui.nodos_porque_firma: Finish step 1 first: sign the bout.
ui.nodos_porque: Tick the box above to send.
ui.nodos_listo: Ready: sending asks for your consent signature.
ui.nodos_rech_gesto: it needs a real tap on the button.
ui.nodos_rech_firma: the bout is not signed yet (step 1).
ui.nodos_rech_clave: this browser has no public key yet.
ui.nodos_rech_canal: the rack has nowhere to receive bouts yet ({h}).
ui.nodos_rech_red: no connection to the rack. The bout stays signed on this device.
ui.nodos_rech_otro: this browser could not complete the send.
ui.rack_nota: Hexelion is the center: the Beelink that joins the local PreceptorOS app, the lab and this web. Each state below comes from the node's card, not from decoration.
ui.rack_activo: ACTIVE (declared): {n} measured figure(s) on its card, latest {d}
ui.rack_inactivo: Not active: nothing measured on its card (NO_DATA)
ui.rack_latido: Live heartbeat NO_DATA: this page reads nothing from the rack while it loads
ui.cuenta_nota: One account links three things: the PreceptorOS app on the Beelink, the lab (the rack) and this web. It carries only public data: the node and this browser's public key. No private key, no passphrase.
ui.cuenta_estado: PROPOSAL · unsigned. It becomes the master account only when the Sovereign signs it in the rack's registry.
ui.cuenta_web: Web: this browser's identity {q} · public key {h}…
ui.cuenta_web_sin: Web: no identity in this browser yet (NO_DATA).
ui.cuenta_app: Local app on the Beelink: link NO_DATA until the Sovereign signs it.
ui.cuenta_lab: Lab (the rack): link NO_DATA until the Sovereign signs it.
ui.cuenta_sin_formato: NO_DATA · the format needs this browser's public key.
ui.mapa_leyenda: ◉ clear = measured · ▒ fog = emulated · ◌ dashed = NO_DATA (not measured)
